description: Answer-oriented web research in one call: searches, keeps the best-scoring results and returns their full page content with numbered sources for citation. Prefer this over search+fetch when you need to read sources, not just find them.

after.description: Only pages dated after this: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

before.description: Only pages dated before this: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

localization.description: Optional IP address used to localize results.

query.description: Search query to use instead of the question. Required if the question exceeds 128 chars.

question.description: The question to research, in the user's words.

sites.description: Only return results from these domains, e.g. ["github.com"].

name: deepseek_research
title: DeepSeek research
